headline: India Slashes Prices of 137 Cancer Drugs Following Supreme Court Ruling
summary: The Indian government moved to enforce mandatory price cuts across 137 cancer medications starting next month, following a Supreme Court ruling that characterized excessive pharmaceutical mark-ups as extortion.
why: India is the world's most populous nation and a major market for global and domestic pharmaceutical producers. Capped medication prices alter revenue margins for oncology drugmakers in developing markets.

impacts.name: Pharmaceuticals
impacts.why: Statutory retail price caps compress operating profit margins on branded oncology treatments in India.
